meta.title: PO History Prefill: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify whether PO History Prefill is refused or absent.
Use PO History Prefill to prefill the PO form from the last PO, then repeat the action as a Buyer and compare availability.
Verify or select the same Growth-plan tenant for both role comparisons.
